newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lagardere sees multimedia profit in 1998.
newsitem.headline: Lagardere sees multimedia profit in 1998.

text.p: Lagardere Groupe does not expect to make a profit on its Grollier multimedia activities until 1998, Arnaud Lagardere told a news conference.

"We will hit the break-even point during 1997 and 1998 will be the first full year that we will be above break-even," Lagardere, son of the founder Jean-Luc Lagardere and head of the Grollier activities said.
"In 1996 our contribution to the group will be slightly negative but it will be an improvement over the previous year," he added.
Lagardere Groupe does not provide detailed results for its multimedia activities.
Arnaud Lagardere said sales were about 2.5 billion francs and had increased by 12 percent in two years while operating profit had progressed by 22 percent.
Lagardere Groupe is expected to publish its 1996 sales in early February and its results in April.
